verification.validation: AI operation semantics in the v2 registry. Non-root api and bridge Go tests in the SDK gate image (new per-field validation, defaults, gate table, undo receipt and runtime-namespace coexistence tests), gofmt, sdk-version and documentation version checks, and an internal-content scan of the repository. Unchanged generation was checked against existing v2 App registries and the native-go/node/python templates with CLI before/after artifacts. npm packages rebuilt by prepack from the merged release commit and content-scanned. No full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: The v2 operation registry adds the ai classes propose, local and one-click and optional consent, targets, risk, tier, undo, audit, mcp, dynamicProvider and labels fields.
ValidateOperationRegistry checks the new fields with errors that name the field; registries without them validate unchanged.
api.NewToolCatalog lists static AI tools with per-turn runtime namespaces; runtime tools bind to dynamicProvider operations and inherit their gate, consent, audit and undo.
Apps using the new fields need CLI 0.53.7 or later.
